item.title: The End of a Fair Price: Dynamic Pricing and the Normalization of Gouging
item.description:
📝 Never mind that corporate profits were soaring, or that companies were using new techniques to personalize prices and even turning over their pricing decisions to third-party consultants making use of artificial intelligence. Three years later, Owens went viral again with a white paper about Instacart’s brief dalliance with personalized pricing. The problem is that personalized pricing is a form of first-degree price discrimination, and the benefits from third-degree price discrimination do not carry over.
🔗 Read more: https://prospect.org/2026/09/29/oct-2026-battling-an-army-of-price-setters-owens-review/
